gaps: P0: nothing. P5: nothing (most hits are Hanover Street, Boston, and Hanover Square, New York). P6: only a 2007 360° panorama from a university tower (#31) without recognizable landmarks.
notes: Eltzner’s bird’s-eye view (#9): the Rijksmuseum dates it only 1826–1891; Commons files it under 1854, which fits Eltzner’s career (born 1816) — reviewer may want to confirm. P3 alternative: the colored Waterloo Platz lithograph (#11, about 1835, very high resolution). The photochroms of Göttingen and Hameln are other towns in the Province of Hanover; Welfenschloss (#21) and Herrenhausen (#22) are genuine Hanover but single buildings.
